description: CAT-D, shared index candidates. Child C(ID, PID) with two enforced relations R1 (P.ID to C.PID) and R2 (P2.ID to C.PID) over the same foreign-key column; C's Indexes are listed (refreshed) after each relation; inserts of C rows are tried with PID present in both parents, in one only and in neither (Errors before/after); P2's key is deleted (3200 expected where enforced); R1 is deleted and the indexes of C are listed again; the insert is repeated. Asks whether the relations share one foreign index and which relation raises each refusal.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
